# glpi_ip_address (Resource)

GLPI IP address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_network_name" "gateway" {
  name = "gateway"
}

resource "glpi_ip_address" "gateway" {
  name      = "192.168.50.1"
  item_type = "NetworkName"
  item_id   = glpi_network_name.gateway.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) IP address, for example 10.77.0.254.

### Optional

- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `item_id` (Number) ID of the item that owns the address.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype of the item that owns the address, usually NetworkName.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version, 4 or 6, computed by GLPI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_ip_address.example 42
```
